meta.source: Warhammer 40,000 Boarding Actions rules + Boarding Actions Compendium (official download, warhammer-community.com)
meta.description: Boarding Actions — close-quarters battles aboard space hulks and voidships on Gallowdark terrain

modeRules.battlefield: 28" x 48" (two Boarding Actions game boards laid side by side)
modeRules.terrain: Gallowdark terrain: wall pieces, hatchways and architectural elements built to the mission's terrain layout

armyConstruction.roster: A Boarding Patrol of up to 500 points
armyConstruction.detachments: Choose one of the 55 Boarding Actions detachments from the Compendium — each faction has bespoke mustering rules
armyConstruction.datasheets: Datasheet adjustments per faction account for the unique constraints of shipboard fighting (unit sizes, excluded units, modified abilities)

coreChanges.hatchways: Walls divide the board into rooms and corridors. New 'Operate Hatchway' action opens/closes doors; nearby enemy models can resist, resulting in a Strength-based roll-off over the door
coreChanges.visibility: True line of sight is heavily restricted by walls — most fighting is room to room
coreChanges.tacticalManeuvers: During the Shooting phase, eligible units can forfeit shooting and charging to perform Tactical Maneuver actions unique to this mode
coreChanges.reserves: Heavily restricted; most missions deploy everything on the boards
coreChanges.engagement: Modified engagement and movement rules for fighting through hatchways and along corridors

sequence: Muster Boarding Patrols (500 pts, one Boarding Actions detachment each)
Determine mission and build the terrain layout
Play the mission's battle rounds, scoring per mission
notes: Rules live in the free Boarding Actions download + the Boarding Actions Compendium (55 detachments, all-faction mustering)
